module_summary: 8-bit XNOR-feedback LFSR advancing when enabled, whose low bits are output as binary and one-hot refill-way selections.

anchors.name: shift_q
anchors.why: LFSR state register, shifted with feedback bit and decoded into way outputs.

anchors.name: refill_way_oh_o
anchors.why: One-hot way select decoded from low LFSR bits.

anchors.name: refill_way_bin_o
anchors.why: Binary way index taken directly from LFSR state.

anchors.name: shift_in
anchors.why: XNOR feedback of taps 7,3,2,1 shifted into the LFSR.

groups.name: lfsr
groups.description: 8-bit LFSR with XNOR feedback, synchronous clear to Seed.

groups.name: way_decode
groups.description: Decodes LFSR low bits into one-hot and binary refill way.
